title: 5.6.2 The position of cases charge-sheeted to total cases for investigation was quite satisfactory for all the crimes committed against Women when compared to national average of (54.6%) for total IPC crimes. Only in case of ‘Kidnapping & Abduction of Women & Girls’ the percentage was lower (36.1%) than the national average. 5.6.3 The percentage of charge-sheeted cases under SLL at national level stood at 84.7. Comparatively, the charge-sheet percentage in cases of Dowry Prohibition Act and Indecent Representation of Women (Prohibition) Act was lower than the national average being 59.3% and 81.3% respectively.
